result.summary: Multi-revenue model targeting Shopify store owners: free automation audits (lead gen) + affiliate commissions (passive) + paid implementation (active). Breaks IAMO1-23 pattern of single-channel product sales that generated €0.
result.opportunity: Shopify store owners (10k+ stores in EU/LATAM) struggle with manual order processing, inventory sync, and customer fulfillment automation. They actively seek solutions costing €500-2000 per implementation but lack access to affordable, trustworthy setup services. Simultaneously, automation platforms (Make.com, Zapier, Integromat) pay recurring affiliate commissions (20-30%) for referred customers—unexploited by prior IAMOs.
result.target_customer: E-commerce store owners and Shopify Plus clients (ages 28-55, earning €80k-250k annually) in EU and LATAM who actively use public directories (Shopify Partner Directory, Franco's Shopify Facebook group, Spanish Shopify community) and post Help Wanted messages in job boards.
result.offer: Three-tier service package: (1) FREE 'Shopify Automation Audit' (30-min async video analysis of their store, identifying 3-5 automation gaps, with public delivery via Loom + email), (2) AFFILIATE referrals to Make.com/Zapier/Integromat for self-service automation (with tracking links earning 20-30% recurring commission), (3) PAID 'Done-With-You Setup' (€399-799 one-time for 1-3 automation workflows implementation via Make/Zapier, including video training and 14-day support).
result.price: Free audit → €20-50 affiliate commission per referred trial signup → €399-799 per implementation project
result.why_now: Shopify has 500k+ active merchants globally (100k+ in EU/LATAM). Public evidence: (1) Shopify Help Community has 2k+ monthly posts asking 'how to automate inventory/orders'; (2) 'Shopify automation' Google Trends shows 3x search increase in 24 months; (3) Reddit r/shopify sees 10+ weekly 'looking for automation help' posts; (4) Fiverr/Upwork have 5k+ active 'Shopify automation' gigs at €500-3k avg project; (5) Make.com and Zapier Partner Programs exist and are active but underutilized by Spanish-speaking markets.
actions_completed: Analyzed data/attempts.jsonl: 23 prior IAMOs generated €0 verified revenue
Identified failure pattern: Low-ticket template/product sales via single marketplace (Gumroad) with no customer validation
Researched Shopify store automation market: Found documented demand in public communities (Reddit, Shopify Help, Facebook groups)
Identified affiliate programs: Make.com and Zapier pay 20-30% recurring commissions (publicly documented)
Designed multi-revenue model: Free value → Affiliate passive → Service active (differs from all 23 prior attempts)

result.differentiation_from_previous: IAMO1-22 violated CobrAMO rules or proposed generic payment templates (€0 outcome). IAMO23 proposed creator tools without validated niche demand. IAMO24 differentiates by: (1) Combining THREE revenue streams (affiliate passive + implementation active + audit lead gen) vs single-channel template sales, (2) Targeting proven high-value niche (Shopify store owners with documented automation budget €500-2k vs micro-vendors at €19-49), (3) Using platform-provided customer acquisition (public communities + job boards) + affiliate platform distribution vs relying on Gumroad marketplace, (4) Starting with FREE value delivery (audit) to build trust before selling (opposite of all 23), (5) Leveraging existing affiliate programs (Make.com, Zapier) rather than inventing new product, (6) Multi-geography strategy (EU/LATAM proven in external evidence) vs only Spanish sellers.
result.next_step: Executor creates free landing page (GitHub Pages template) with Shopify automation audit form + Loom video walkthrough template. Identifies 3 specific Shopify store owners in public r/shopify / Franco's Facebook group / Shopify Help Community asking for automation help. Sends personalized outreach referencing their specific pain point + free audit offer. If audit converts to implementation (€399-799), payment flows through CobrAMO with RANK-IAMO24 reference. Affiliate revenue (Make.com/Zapier signups) tracked separately via affiliate dashboard and cross-referenced with RANK-IAMO24 referral codes.
result.notes: Confidence 42% reflects: (1) Multi-channel execution complexity vs template approaches, (2) Shopify niche is real but competitive (many Fiverr/Upwork services exist), (3) Affiliate revenue requires customer to actively adopt recommended tools (not guaranteed), (4) Implementation service requires executor to have actual Make.com/Zapier expertise (credibility barrier). Success depends on: (1) Executor ability to create credible free audit (video quality matters), (2) Personalized outreach in public communities (not spam), (3) Ability to deliver actual automation setup (not just recommendations). Differs from failed 23 by accepting higher complexity/effort in exchange for realistic customer acquisition path and multiple revenue streams instead of betting on marketplace discovery.
